text:
laura: Heads-up — I'll deploy a small routing hotpatch at 15:00 PT. Plan: 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% over ~20m. I’ll kick off with deploy-bot and run quick postpatch checks. Need one SRE to watch metrics and traces during rollout.

mike: I can cover 15:00–15:30 PT. What exact checks do you want me to run?

laura: Main checks: p95 latency for text-gen, overall 5xx rate <0.2%, queue depth/backpressure, and routing correctness (requests hitting fallback path when expected). Also verify embedding route still routes to dedicated pools. Quick commands:

```
# prometheus examples
up: promql
sum(rate(http_server_requests_total{route="/v1/generate"}[5m]))
quantile(0.95, rate(latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m]))
# simple healthcheck
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"hello"}'
```

deploy-bot: Started canary routing-hotpatch-2026 at 15:00 PT -> 5% traffic. :rocket:

steph: +1 on watch. 5m in: no p95 regressions, p50 stable. GPU utilization +3% on canary nodes.

ash: if 5xx > 0.3% we rollback. Rollback runbook ready in #eng-releases-runbooks.

mike: I'll watch traces and the embeddings route. Noted on thresholds.

laura: After 10m if stable I'll bump to 25%. mike, confirm you can escalate to broader watch if we see anything.

mike: Confirmed. Ready to escalate.

deploy-bot: Canary bumped to 25% at 15:12 PT.

steph: 25% looks healthy. Single 5xx spike at 15:16 traced to transient logging DB timeout — retries swallowed it, no user-facing errors. Logged in incident tracker for follow-up.

ash: Acknowledged. We'll schedule an ops ticket for the logging timeout fix. Not blocking rollout.

laura: Running small synthetic eval suite against canary to validate output quality (exact-match + top-k token checks). If output divergence >3% we abort.

```
# run synthetic suite
scripts/run_synth_checks.sh --env canary --suite smoke_gen
```

mike: Synthetic checks pass locally and on canary. 

deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% at 15:28 PT.

steph: 100% live. Dashboards clean, traces show no new error clusters. Setting 1h watch window; mike is primary.

mike: On watch for 60m. Ping me on slack or pager if anything pops.

ash: Fast rollback command prepped: `deploy rollback routing-hotpatch-2026` — expect <2m to cut traffic back.

laura: Thanks all — follow-ups: create PR to bump logging timeout, add a small prometheus alert for routing-fallback-rate, and mark the deploy ticket DONE after the watch window. :thumbsup:

mike: +1. Good run. :rocket:

sre-oncall: Watching silently; reachable if needed.

laura: Closing thread after watch window. Will ping if we need to revert.
